# BLE Session Appliance CLI

Generated by the Printing Press from a BLE device spec.

This CLI is device-native: commands refer to BLE device capabilities rather than HTTP endpoints. The first generated runtime uses replay transport so verification does not connect to or actuate a physical device.

## Commands

- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli status --json` prints replay-backed status fields.
- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli capabilities --json` prints callable and withheld BLE capabilities with safety metadata.
- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli start --dry-run --json` previews the start BLE write.
- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli session start --json` creates the local replay session runtime lock, token, and endpoint metadata.
- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli session status --json` prints the local replay session runtime state.
- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli telemetry capture --json` stores replay-backed telemetry samples locally.
- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli telemetry latest --json` reads the latest locally stored telemetry samples.
- `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli telemetry sessions --json` reads locally stored BLE session summaries.
